verdict.rationale: Box documents collaborations as role-based access control on files/folders (viewer/editor/owner-style roles), granting users/groups access with defined roles, and separately documents shared links with configurable access levels — covering folder/file-level permissioning. However, evidence does not explicitly enumerate the full role set (viewer/commenter/editor/owner) nor detail inheritance behavior (how folder-level roles propagate to subfolders/files) beyond general statements. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the full role hierarchy/names, and explicit inheritance rules/override behavior for nested folders and files.
